nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.desc: Strong summer sun drives growth on the steppe and in the shallow lake, while long cold winters freeze the lake from October to May.

nodes.name: Mountain streams and rivers
nodes.desc: Rivers such as the Tes carry mountain water down to the basin, which has no outflow to the sea.

nodes.name: Saline lake water
nodes.desc: Uvs Lake is shallow and salty, at roughly half the salinity of the ocean, because salts build up in a basin with no outlet.

nodes.name: Steppe and desert soil
nodes.desc: Dry, often salty soils hold the nutrients that grasses, shrubs and trees draw on, and are replenished by decomposers.

nodes.name: Soil microbes and fungi
nodes.desc: Break down dead plants, carcasses and droppings, returning nutrients to the soil.

nodes.name: Steppe grasses
nodes.desc: Tussock grasses typical of dry Central Asian steppe, grazed by wild hoofed animals, hares and rodents.

nodes.name: Mountain taiga trees and shrubs
nodes.desc: Siberian pine and fir forest grows on the cooler mountain slopes of the basin, mainly on the Russian side.

nodes.name: Phytoplankton
nodes.desc: Drifting microscopic algae in the shallow lake that feed zooplankton. General ecological knowledge.

nodes.name: Argali
nodes.desc: The world's largest wild sheep, grazing grasses, sedges and herbs in mountains. Altai argali live in western Mongolia and are hunted by wolves and snow leopards.

nodes.name: Siberian ibex
nodes.desc: A mountain goat of rocky slopes in the basin's ranges and a main prey of the snow leopard in Mongolia's Altai.

nodes.name: Siberian roe deer
nodes.desc: A small deer of forest-steppe that browses herbs and woody shoots; wolves and snow leopards prey on it.

nodes.name: Tolai hare
nodes.desc: A hare of open steppe and desert that eats grasses and shrubs and is prey for foxes, eagles and falcons.

nodes.name: Mongolian five-toed jerboa
nodes.desc: A hopping desert rodent that eats seeds and plants and is hunted by foxes, falcons and eagles.

nodes.name: Demoiselle crane
nodes.desc: A small crane nesting on the steppe and wetland edge, eating seeds, shoots and insects. Recorded often near the lake.

nodes.name: Zooplankton
nodes.desc: Tiny crustaceans that graze algae in lake water and feed small fish. General ecological knowledge.

nodes.name: Altai osman and lake fish
nodes.desc: A cyprinid fish of Mongolia and Tuva; the Uvs Lake area has about 29 fish species in all, and the osman is the one eaten by people.

nodes.name: Great cormorant
nodes.desc: A diving fish-eater of lakes, one of the most recorded birds around Uvs Lake.

nodes.name: Saker falcon
nodes.desc: A falcon of open grassland that hunts rodents and birds and is Mongolia's national bird.

nodes.name: Corsac fox
nodes.desc: A small steppe fox that hunts jerboas, hares and waterbirds, with GloBI records of these meals.

nodes.name: Common raven
nodes.desc: A clever omnivore that scavenges carcasses left by large predators.

nodes.name: Snow leopard
nodes.desc: An endangered cat of the basin's mountains. In Mongolia it preys on argali, ibex and roe deer.

nodes.name: Wolf
nodes.desc: The main predator of argali, also taking roe deer and hares, especially in harsh winters.

nodes.name: Steppe eagle
nodes.desc: A large raptor of open steppe that hunts jerboas, hares and small foxes, with GloBI records of these meals.
